scenes.vo: Hai giờ sáng, bốn người đeo mặt nạ đập vỡ cửa kính một tiệm thẻ Pokémon,
scenes.gloss: Two in the morning, four masked men smash the glass door of a Pokémon card shop,
scenes.viewer: From inside the dark shop: a sledgehammer through the glass door, four masks outside.
scenes.build: new: the shop interior at night (case LEDs on), the glass door with its pane; outside the sidewalk under a sodium lamp.
scenes.blocking: A on the sidewalk 1 m from the door (hook A), B, C, D behind him (hook marks), all front view; after the smash they step in to the inside marks.
scenes.action: f0-40 A plants his feet, the sledgehammer hanging; f40-50 wind-up over his right shoulder, held f50-56; f60 contact on the glass (2 f before 'đập' f62): the pane bursts into ~40 rigid-body shards flying in toward the lens; f60-110 shards fall, skid and settle on the tile floor (they stay for the whole reel); f68-112 A, then B, C, D step through the empty frame into the shop; the camera pulls back and up into the aisle, the lit cases come into the foreground on 'tiệm thẻ Pokémon'.
scenes.acting: A: effort squint on the wind-up, a grin after; the others crouch-ready.

cams.why: through the glass door at the four masks
pull back into the shop as they come in

marks.pose: hook: A wind-up f40-56, strike f60; all step in f68-112
hook: A wind-up f40-56, strike f60; all step in f68-112
hook: A wind-up f40-56, strike f60; all step in f68-112
hook: A wind-up f40-56, strike f60; all step in f68-112

scenes.physics: door shards: ~40 thin glass plates (2-12 cm, 2.5 kg/m2) released at f60 from the pane, velocity 1.5-3.5 m/s inward (-z) + spread, cannon-es 240 Hz against the floor; restitution 0.2, friction 0.6; they come to rest by f100.
scenes.light_mood: night blue; a warm sodium lamp outside, the case LEDs inside.
scenes.sound: silence and a hum; a swish f52; a huge glass crash f60 (the score hits); shard tinkles f66-100; footsteps on glass f70-110.
scenes.after: The door frame is empty; shards lie on the floor inside (S04, S05, S23).

scenes.vo: mang theo kìm cộng lực, và một chiếc xe đi thuê.

scenes.action: f132-146 B lifts the bolt cutters to chest height and opens the handles, f150 he snaps them shut (jaws clack on 'kìm' f144-158); f160-200 the camera travels out through the empty door frame to the street: the white minivan idles at the curb, exhaust puffs, the RENTAL barcode sticker on its rear side window; f185 and f195 the hazard lights blink on 'xe đi thuê'.

cams.why: out the door to the van

marks.pose: bolt cutters up f132, snap f150

scenes.physics: the cutter jaws: 3 f close, a 1 f rebound.
scenes.sound: a metallic clack f150; engine idle and a hazard tick f185, f195.
scenes.after: The van idles at the curb.

scenes.vo: Bốn tủ kính vỡ tan.
scenes.gloss: Four glass cases shattered.
scenes.viewer: Four tools, four case tops, one per word.

scenes.sound: four glass crashes f350, f363, f369, f377, each a tone higher.

scenes.blocking: Clerk behind the counter; A at the counter; B, C, D queue to the right.

cams.why: the masked customer and the queue

scenes.physics: none.
scenes.sound: a record scratch + Huh (meme) f1105; a printer whirr; a slow 'hmm' f1176.

scenes.vo: Bạn thấy đấy, mặt nạ che được khuôn mặt, nhưng chiếc xe thuê nhớ từng con đường nó đi qua, còn chiếc điện thoại trong túi nhớ từng cột sóng nó chạm vào.
scenes.gloss: You see, a mask hides a face, but a rental car remembers every road it took, and the phone in your pocket remembers every tower it touched.
scenes.viewer: The masked face, then from above: the route lights up gold behind the van, and towers ping as the phone passes.
scenes.build: reuse the highway; new: the gold trail ribbon, the cell towers with top lamps and ping rings, the phone pulse on the van.
scenes.blocking: A at the wheel.
scenes.action: f1206-1262 the van waits at the stop sign, the masked driver in the window ('mặt nạ che được khuôn mặt' f1239-1271); f1262 it pulls away (1.5 m/s2 up to 22 m/s); f1272-1372 the camera cranes up to an aerial; f1318-1350 'nhớ từng con đường' a gold trail floods along the road it came by, up to the van, and keeps drawing behind it; f1407, f1417, f1427, f1438, f1447 the van passes a tower: a blue ring pulses off the van (the phone) and the tower's top lamp lights and stays lit.

scenes.physics: van: kinematic along the route (d = 153 + 1.5 t^2).
scenes.light_mood: night; the gold trail and blue pings glow.
scenes.sound: a warm 'you see' pad; a rising shimmer as the trail floods f1318; a sonar 'blip' per tower f1407-1447.

scenes.vo: Đeo mặt nạ mà mang điện thoại, khác gì chơi trốn tìm mà cầm loa.
scenes.gloss: Wearing a mask but carrying a phone is like playing hide-and-seek holding a megaphone.
scenes.viewer: A masked man hides behind a hedge holding a megaphone; it rings, and the seeker at the tree turns round.
scenes.build: new: the front yard in Justice at night (hedge, maple, porch light).
scenes.blocking: Seeker (cop) at the tree facing it (side view), counting; A crouched behind the hedge, megaphone at his mouth.

scenes.physics: hedge leaves: a 2 cm shiver 12 f.
scenes.sound: crickets; counting murmur; Yo Phone Ringing (meme) blasted f1550.

scenes.vo: Cảnh sát gom camera, hồ sơ thuê xe, dữ liệu định vị, lịch sử điện thoại, cả dấu vân tay,
scenes.gloss: Police gathered the cameras, the rental record, location data, phone history, even fingerprints,

scenes.sound: a pin 'tock' per item f1600-1720; a typewriter-ish tick bed.
scenes.after: Five items on the board linked by string.

scenes.vo: rồi lần thẳng đến một ngôi nhà ở thị trấn
scenes.gloss: and traced it straight to a house in the village of
scenes.viewer: The red string runs from the evidence to a pin on the map: Justice.
